recommendation.headline: Clean frame — no hot pixels. Don't favor or avoid any ball.
recommendation.detail: No ball clears the family-wise bar (|z| ≥ 3.33) and repeats in both halves. Every ball is equally likely, so the best play is screened random tickets with a different Powerball on each — same expected value, ~5× the chance of any Powerball prize versus repeating one, and fewer split jackpots.
